description: This file contains implementation of helper functions for file operations, including obtaining directory paths, generating random filenames, and file content verification, primarily used in testing within the starboard/nplb namespace.

classes.name: ScopedRandomFile
classes.description: Utility class for creating temporary files with random content for testing purposes, including methods for generating filenames, creating files, and pattern verification.

methods.name: GetTempDir
methods.description: Retrieves the temporary directory path using SbSystemGetPath.

methods.name: GetFileTestsDataDir
methods.description: Constructs the directory path for test data files, verifying its existence.

methods.name: MakePathsVector
methods.description: Creates a vector of absolute file paths from relative paths, converting slashes to platform-specific delimiters.

methods.name: GetFileTestsFilePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of test file paths used in file-related tests.

methods.name: GetFileTestsDirectoryPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of directory paths used in directory-related tests.

methods.name: GetTestFileExpectedContent
methods.description: Generates expected content for a test file based on its filename.
